timing: After collection and during raw tool-trace validation; not preregistered as a separate exclusion label.
finding: Some Antigravity runs attempted view_file despite the no-local-files instruction. Returned file content is not visible in the stream. Paths include the empty working directory, nonexistent-looking test files, and a CLI bundled guide.
decision: Keep raw attempts unchanged. A provider-completed response with any non-web tool attempt is marked protocol_deviation and excluded from primary recommendation counts and denominators. Failed runs stay failures. Do not infer that experiment data was actually read.
web_tool_name_correction: read_url_content is an allowed web URL tool, not an unrequested local tool. Count ACTIVE calls once; retain ACTIVE and DONE trace rows.
sensitivity: Raw provider-completed outcomes remain in attempts.jsonl for inclusive sensitivity analysis. The primary report uses protocol-eligible responses only.
authorization: No extra permissions or persistent CLI settings were granted, and denied URL reads were not bypassed.
